# Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
> FAO is the UN specialized agency for food, agriculture, fisheries, forestry, nutrition, and rural development.

FAO.org is the organization’s primary web platform for policy guidance, statistical data, publications, country and regional work, technical programmes, emergency response, and global knowledge resources supporting better production, better nutrition, a better environment, and a better life.

## Organization
- [Home](https://www.fao.org/home/en): FAO homepage with access to news, priorities, programmes, and key resources.
- [About FAO](https://www.fao.org/about/en): Overview of FAO’s mandate, governance, leadership, and organizational structure.
- [Members Gateway](https://www.fao.org/members-gateway/en): Information for FAO Members on governance, meetings, and institutional processes.
- [Director-General](https://www.fao.org/director-general/en): Profile, speeches, statements, and activities of the FAO Director-General.
- [Strategic Framework](https://www.fao.org/strategic-framework/en): FAO’s strategic direction and programme priorities for transforming agrifood systems.
- [Transparency Portal](https://www.fao.org/transparency/en): Budget, programme, and financial transparency information for FAO operations.
- [Partnerships](https://www.fao.org/partnerships/en): Collaboration with governments, civil society, academia, and the private sector.
- [Careers](https://www.fao.org/employment/en): FAO employment opportunities, recruitment information, and talent programmes.

## Topics and Technical Areas
- [Topics](https://www.fao.org/topics/en): Entry point to FAO’s thematic and technical work across agrifood systems.
- [Food security and nutrition](https://www.fao.org/food-security/en): Resources on hunger, food access, nutrition, and food security policy.
- [Climate change](https://www.fao.org/climate-change/en): FAO work on climate adaptation, mitigation, and resilient agrifood systems.
- [Biodiversity](https://www.fao.org/biodiversity/en): Guidance and initiatives on biodiversity for food and agriculture.
- [Forestry](https://www.fao.org/forestry/en): Forest policy, management, restoration, and global forest knowledge resources.
- [Fisheries and aquaculture](https://www.fao.org/fisheries/en): Technical information on fisheries, aquaculture, and aquatic food systems.
- [Land and water](https://www.fao.org/land-water/en): FAO work on soils, irrigation, water resources, and sustainable land management.
- [Animal production and health](https://www.fao.org/animal-production/en): Programmes and guidance on livestock systems, animal health, and production.

## Data, Statistics and Knowledge Platforms
- [Statistics](https://www.fao.org/statistics/en): Gateway to FAO statistical systems, databases, and methodological resources.
- [FAOSTAT](https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#home): Core statistical database for food, agriculture, trade, emissions, and resources.
- [Country Profiles](https://www.fao.org/countryprofiles/en): Country-level information on FAO activities, data, and national context.
- [Hand-in-Hand Geospatial Platform](https://www.fao.org/hih-geospatial-platform/en): Geospatial data platform supporting investment and territorial targeting.
- [AQUASTAT](https://www.fao.org/aquastat/en): Global information system on water resources, irrigation, and agricultural water use.
- [FAOLEX](https://www.fao.org/faolex/en): Database of national laws, policies, and treaties on food and agriculture.
- [AGRIS](https://agris.fao.org/): International bibliographic database for agricultural science and technology literature.
- [FAO Knowledge Repository](https://www.fao.org/publications/en): Publications portal for reports, briefs, guidelines, and flagship outputs.

## Publications and Flagship Reports
- [Publications](https://www.fao.org/publications/en): Search and browse FAO books, reports, policy papers, and technical documents.
- [The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World](https://www.fao.org/publications/sofi/en): Annual flagship report on hunger, food insecurity, and nutrition.
- [The State of Food and Agriculture](https://www.fao.org/publications/sofa/en): Flagship analysis of major agricultural and food system issues.
- [The State of the World’s Forests](https://www.fao.org/publications/sofo/en): Global assessment of forests, forestry trends, and policy priorities.
- [The State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture](https://www.fao.org/publications/sofia/en): Flagship report on fisheries, aquaculture, and aquatic resources.
- [The State of Agricultural Commodity Markets](https://www.fao.org/publications/soco/en): Analysis of agricultural commodity markets and trade developments.
- [The State of the World’s Land and Water Resources for Food and Agriculture](https://www.fao.org/publications/solaw/en): Assessment of land and water resources for agriculture.
- [Corporate Document Repository](https://www.fao.org/3/en): Access point for FAO documents and publication series.

## Emergencies and Resilience
- [Emergencies](https://www.fao.org/emergencies/en): FAO emergency and resilience work in food crises and disaster contexts.
- [Food Coalition](https://www.fao.org/food-coalition/en): Global multi-stakeholder initiative supporting responses to food crises.
- [Desert Locust](https://www.fao.org/locusts/en): Monitoring, alerts, and technical resources on desert locust threats.
- [One Health](https://www.fao.org/one-health/en): Cross-sector work on human, animal, plant, and ecosystem health.
- [Antimicrobial Resistance](https://www.fao.org/antimicrobial-resistance/en): FAO guidance and programmes addressing antimicrobial resistance in agrifood systems.
- [Fall Armyworm Monitoring and Early Warning System](https://www.fao.org/fall-armyworm-monitoring/en): Monitoring tools and information on fall armyworm spread and management.

## Programmes and Initiatives
- [Hand-in-Hand Initiative](https://www.fao.org/hand-in-hand/en): Country-led initiative using data to accelerate agrifood transformation and investment.
- [One Country One Priority Product](https://www.fao.org/one-country-one-priority-product/en): Initiative promoting sustainable value chains for special agricultural products.
- [1000 Digital Villages Initiative](https://www.fao.org/digital-villages-initiative/en): Programme supporting digital transformation in rural communities.
- [Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems](https://www.fao.org/giahs/en): Recognition and support for traditional agricultural heritage systems worldwide.
- [Codex Alimentarius](https://www.fao.org/fao-who-codexalimentarius/en): International food standards programme jointly run by FAO and WHO.
- [International Plant Protection Convention](https://www.fao.org/plant-treaty/en): International framework and resources related to plant genetic resources.
- [World Food Forum](https://www.fao.org/world-food-forum/en): FAO-hosted platform engaging youth, science, and investment communities.

## Countries and Regions
- [Regional Offices](https://www.fao.org/regional-offices/en): Access to FAO regional office websites and regional priorities.
- [Africa](https://www.fao.org/africa/en): Regional work, news, and programmes across the African continent.
- [Asia and the Pacific](https://www.fao.org/asiapacific/en): Regional resources and country support in Asia and the Pacific.
- [Europe and Central Asia](https://www.fao.org/europe/en): Regional initiatives, publications, and country activities in Europe and Central Asia.
- [Latin America and the Caribbean](https://www.fao.org/americas/en): Regional programmes and policy support in Latin America and the Caribbean.
- [Near East and North Africa](https://www.fao.org/neareast/en): Regional work on food security, water, and resilience in NENA countries.
- [Country Offices](https://www.fao.org/country-offices/en): Directory and information on FAO representation at country level.

## News and Media
- [Newsroom](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/en): Central hub for FAO news, announcements, and media materials.
- [Stories](https://www.fao.org/stories/en): Feature stories highlighting FAO impact, projects, and communities.
- [Events](https://www.fao.org/events/en): Calendar of FAO conferences, observances, launches, and meetings.
- [Press releases](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/search?category=pressrelease): Official FAO press release archive and announcements.
- [Videos](https://www.fao.org/video/en): Video library covering FAO programmes, interviews, and explainers.
- [Podcasts](https://www.fao.org/podcasts/en): Audio content on agrifood systems, policy, and global challenges.
- [Media contacts](https://www.fao.org/newsroom/media-contacts/en): Contact information and resources for journalists and media professionals.

## Learning and Capacity Development
- [FAO elearning Academy](https://www.fao.org/elearning/en): Online courses and learning programmes on food and agriculture topics.
- [Capacity Development](https://www.fao.org/capacity-development/en): FAO support for institutional, technical, and policy capacities.
- [Farmer Field Schools](https://www.fao.org/farmer-field-schools/en): Participatory learning approach for farmers and rural communities.
- [Food safety](https://www.fao.org/food-safety/en): Technical guidance and learning resources on food safety systems.
- [Nutrition](https://www.fao.org/nutrition/en): Knowledge, tools, and policy support on nutrition and healthy diets.
- [Gender](https://www.fao.org/gender/en): FAO work on gender equality and women’s empowerment in agrifood systems.

## Digital Services and Portals
- [FAO API Portal](https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data): Programmatic access entry point through FAOSTAT datasets and data services.
- [Document search](https://www.fao.org/publications/search/en): Search interface for FAO publications and documents.
- [Terms and definitions](https://www.fao.org/faoterm/en): Multilingual terminology resource for food and agriculture concepts.
- [WAICENT](https://www.fao.org/waicent/en): FAO information management and knowledge dissemination resources.
- [Procurement](https://www.fao.org/unfao/procurement/en): Procurement opportunities, vendor information, and tender resources.
- [Contact us](https://www.fao.org/contact-us/en): General contact information and enquiry channels for FAO.
